changelog:
Initial release of China-Check skill for verifying mainland-China companies:

- Enables lookup and verification of PRC companies using official GSXT/SAMR data.
- Provides two tools: search companies by multiple criteria, and retrieve official registration snapshots.
- Includes detailed usage workflow and best practices for presenting company data.
- Covers only mainland-China businesses (excludes Hong Kong, Macau, Taiwan).
- Free, read-only access via the China-Check MCP server; no authentication required.
